## Description

## Module / Requirement

- Related requirement ID: (e.g. FR-10, NFR-02, or "n/a")

## Steps to reproduce
1. Log in as (role: donor / requester / admin)
2. Go to ...
3. Click ...
4. See the problem

## Expected behavior
What should happen.

## Actual behavior
What happens instead.

## Severity
- [ ] Critical (system unusable, data loss, security problem)
- [ ] High (major feature broken, no workaround)
- [ ] Medium (feature partly broken, workaround exists)
- [ ] Low (cosmetic or minor)

## Environment
- Browser and version:
- OS:
- Branch / commit:

## Evidence
Screenshots, console output or logs (do not include real personal data).

## Possible cause or notes (optional)
Files or classes you suspect.
